CreateAndAnalyzeNetworkPath.description_en: Initiates a task for analyzing network reachability
CreateAndAnalyzeNetworkPath.description_zh: 调用CreateAndAnalyzeNetworkPath接口，发起网络可达性分析任务

CreateNetworkPath.description_en: Creates a network path for reachability analysis
CreateNetworkPath.description_zh: 调用CreateNetworkPath接口，创建网络分析路径，用于云上网络路径可达性分析

CreateNetworkReachableAnalysis.description_en: Creates a task for analyzing network reachability
CreateNetworkReachableAnalysis.description_zh: 调用CreateNetworkReachableAnalysis接口，创建网络可达性分析任务

DeleteNetworkPath.description_zh: 调用DeleteNetworkPath接口，删除网络分析路径

DeleteNetworkReachableAnalysis.description_en: Deletes a network reachability analysis task
DeleteNetworkReachableAnalysis.description_zh: 调用DeleteNetworkReachableAnalysis接口，删除网络可达性分析任务

DescribeNisInspectionRecommendationResou.description_en: Queries the list of anomalous instances in an inspection report
DescribeNisInspectionRecommendationResou.description_zh: 查询巡检报告异常项实例列表

DescribeNisInspectionReportCheckItems.description_en: Queries the details of inspection report check items
DescribeNisInspectionReportCheckItems.description_zh: 查询巡检报告检查项详情

DescribeNisInspectionReportStatus.description_en: Queries the status of an inspection report

DescribeNisInspectionReportSummary.description_en: Queries the summary of an inspection report

DescribeNisInspectionTask.description_en: Queries the details of an inspection task

DescribeNisTrafficRanking.description_en: Queries NIS traffic ranking analysis results
DescribeNisTrafficRanking.description_zh: 查询NIS流量排序分析结果

GetInternetTuple.description_en: Retrieves Internet traffic details ranked by tuple granularity (1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple), with support for sorting by metrics such as traffic volume and packet count
GetInternetTuple.description_zh: 调用GetInternetTuple接口，获取公网流量详情数据排名，覆盖一元组、二元组、五元组粒度，支持按流量、包数等指标排序

GetNatTopN.description_en: Queries the real-time SNAT performance ranking of a NAT gateway
GetNatTopN.description_zh: 调用GetNatTopN接口，获取NAT网关的SNAT转发实时数据排名

GetNetworkReachableAnalysis.description_en: Calls the GetNetworkReachableAnalysis operation to obtain the results of a network reachability analysis task
GetNetworkReachableAnalysis.description_zh: 调用GetNetworkReachableAnalysis接口，获取网络可达性分析结果

GetNisNetworkMetrics.description_en: Retrieves detailed monitoring metric trends data for a specified NIS network analysis scenario, including traffic metric trends for network traffic analysis scenarios and performance metric trends for performance observation scenarios
GetNisNetworkMetrics.description_zh: 支持指定NIS网络分析场景，获取详细监控指标趋势数据，包括流量分析场景下的流量指标趋势数据，以及性能观测场景下的性能指标趋势数据等

GetNisNetworkRanking.description_en: Supports ranking analysis of traffic flowing through different cloud network resources by using sorting algorithms and data processing capabilities, and sorts detection metrics of Alibaba Cloud performance observation to help you quickly identify network bottlenecks, optimize resource configurations, and improve overall network performance
GetNisNetworkRanking.description_zh: 支持通过排序算法和数据处理能力，对流经不同云网络资源的流量进行排名分析，以及对阿里云性能观测的探测指标进行排序，帮助您快速识别网络瓶颈、优化资源配置和提升整体网络效能

GetNisTrafficMetrics.description_en: Retrieves the metric trends for network traffic analysis
GetNisTrafficMetrics.description_zh: 获取流量分析指标趋势

GetTransitRouterFlowTopN.description_en: Queries the rankings of inter-region traffic data in the form of 1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple. Inter-region traffic data can be ranked by metrics such as traffic volumes and the number of packets
GetTransitRouterFlowTopN.description_zh: 调用GetTransitRouterFlowTopN接口，获取跨域流量详情数据排名，覆盖一元组、二元组、五元组粒度，支持按流量、包数等指标排序

GetVbrFlowTopN.description_en: Queries the rankings of hybrid cloud traffic data in the form of 1-tuple, 2-tuple, or 5-tuple. Hybrid cloud traffic data can be ranked by metrics such as traffic volumes and the number of packets
GetVbrFlowTopN.description_zh: 调用GetVbrFlowTopN接口，获取混合云流量详情数据排名，覆盖一元组、二元组、五元组粒度，支持按流量、包数等指标排序

ListNisInspectionResourceType.description_en: Lists the resource types available for inspection
ListNisInspectionResourceType.description_zh: 查询巡检对象产品类型列表

ListNisInspectionTaskReports.description_en: Queries a list of inspection task reports
ListNisInspectionTaskReports.description_zh: 查询巡检任务报告列表

StartNisInspectionTask.description_en: Starts an inspection task to generate an inspection report
StartNisInspectionTask.description_zh: 触发一次巡检任务，产生巡检报告

StartNisTrafficRanking.description_en: Triggers the NIS traffic analyzer to execute a traffic sorting task within a specified scope
StartNisTrafficRanking.description_zh: 触发NIS流量分析器执行指定范围内的流量排序任务
